items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play Sunday vs Jets after limited practice all week following high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Practiced limited all week; sources anticipate return from IR.
items.implication: WR2/3 upside in return; start if active.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in NE offense vs Jets.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; sidelined indefinitely by superficial blood clot; first game without him Sunday, Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Blood clot; info gathering continues, no IR plans.
items.implication: McKee start; pass-catchers still viable but QB downgrade.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers with hamstring; second straight miss.
items.implication: Sit; thin PHI RB room with Shipley also OUT.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2 wherever rostered; possible return relief.
Ravens will play another game without QB Lamar Jackson (ankle).
items.implication: Huntley start; downgrade BAL pass game.

items.text: PIT without WRs Pittman/Roman Wilson/Skowronek: expect heavy 2-WR sets Metcalf + Germie Bernard. PHI McKee with 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce but top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.implication: Metcalf target spike in 2WR; PHI pass-catchers viable despite thin RB/McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes/targets up; PHI WRs/TE snaps secure.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle more probable-like. Doubts legit high-ankle on Henderson given practice.
items.implication: Cautious on unclear ankles/shoulder; lean play on probables.
items.opportunity: Warren possible TE bump if plays.

items.text: Sunday injuries OUT include Lamar Jackson, Saquon Barkley, Jalen Hurts, Will Shipley, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, Breece Hall, David Montgomery, Baker Mayfield.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups (e.g. Pierce in PHI).

items.text: QUESTIONABLE: AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, Caleb Williams, DJ Moore, Tyler Warren, DK Metcalf (illness), Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave (illness), Alvin Kamara, Quinshon Judkins. IN: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.implication: Monitor Qs closely; INs clear for start consideration.
items.opportunity: Full roles for INs; Q clarity pending.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed high-ankle sprain but practiced; surprised he could; NE has TNF next so practice may test for Thursday availability more than this week.
items.why: High-ankle but limited practice; next game TNF factor.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks WR4 for Week 6.
LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume/matchups.
items.why: Usage bankable; leaking run Ds; WSH pass D soft; goal-line for Javonte.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI) due to tough matchups and shaky QB/feed.
HATE J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@KC); LOVE Brock Purdy (vs WSH QB2). Also notes Hurts OUT/McKee and Saquon issues.
items.why: Elite pass D for Nix/Dobbins; low totals for Herbert; high-scoring soft for Purdy.
